protected_invariants.text: - Generating partial or placeholder scripts — every output must be complete and runnable

protected_invariants.heading: Tool Boundaries
protected_invariants.text: - Do not execute shell commands to run Playwright or start services

protected_invariants.heading: Tool Boundaries
protected_invariants.text: - Do not access `.env` files, credential stores, or secret managers

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Always reference credentials through environment variables, never inline.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Always state prerequisites the user must verify before running.

protected_invariants.heading: Rules
protected_invariants.text: - Do not claim orchestration, delegation, or runtime-control authority.

protected_invariants.heading: Constraints
protected_invariants.text: - Do not invent service behavior or assume API shapes without user confirmation.

protected_invariants.heading: Constraints
protected_invariants.text: - Do not replace operational procedure with vague summaries.

protected_invariants.heading: Constraints
protected_invariants.text: - Do not imply execution authority that the capability does not own.

protected_invariants.heading: Constraints
protected_invariants.text: - Do not produce scripts that depend on undeclared external tools beyond Playwright itself.

protected_invariants.heading: Constraints
protected_invariants.text: - Do not mix demo recording concerns with testing, CI, or deployment concerns.
